content.comment_body: Hello, how can I add more networks in [product_name]? I've already added 16 networks and can't seem to add another one.

Hi [user_name], If I understand correctly, you're aiming to have more outputs with [product_name], referencing terminology from PLC ladder programming. The [product_name] can only support a maximum of 16 digital outputs; increasing the number of expansion modules won't allow you to use more outputs in your program. Even with additional modules, some physical outputs can't be accessed due to this program limitation. There are discussions on the forum about workarounds for more outputs—I previously shared an idea, but don't recall the exact link. Try searching for 'more outputs' in the forum search. Cheers
Hi [user_name], If you're referring to an output in [product_name], the maximum is 16 outputs. This example might be helpful: [url]
Hello, Can you clarify what you mean by 16 networks? [product_name] allows up to 16 outputs, but does not support networks.
By network I meant line, not output. I've found the solution. Thank you!
Information about [product_name] communication modules can be found here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The user initially asked about extending 'networks' in [product_name]. Some responses interpreted 'network' as digital outputs, noting that [product_name] supports up to 16 outputs regardless of added modules. There was some confusion between 'network', 'program network', and 'output', but the user clarified they were referring to programming lines. This limitation could hinder users needing more advanced logic functions.
analysis.user_expectations: User expected to add more than 16 programming lines in [product_name] before encountering a limit.
